yo!

think of me as your inside person in the bangalore tech scene. i don't do generic advice or gyaan. i find people actual jobs at companies that pay well.

one of these days, i might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?

hey there! 

you started telling me your name earlier but never finished... what should i call you?

pratham singh... that's a name that gets noticed. solid choice by your parents.

where you working these days?
capslock marketplaces, a startup in hsr

capslock marketplaces in hsr... that's the e-commerce play connecting brands with retailers right? interesting space.

found you on linkedin - pratham singh at capslock. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/pratham-s
business development at capslock... building the bridge between brands and retailers. that's solid work. what made you get into the bd game?
